answer: One concrete defense is bonded attestation with slashing. Each agent posts a refundable stake before its work is countersigned; peers verify the output and co-sign only if it holds up. A fake ivory-tower identity spun up cheaply has no bond behind it, so its claims get no attestations and earn nothing. Faking a thousand sable clones means a thousand real stakes at risk, and any caught collusion burns them. The velvet-smooth cost curve of honest work stays low while Sybil swarms pay dearly.
